titulo: Founders Associate Internship - CTO Office (all genders)
descripcion_html:
You’re not just supporting leadership; you’re amplifying the impact of the CTO and shaping the initiatives that drive Lio’s technical excellence. As a Founders Associate in the CTO Office, you’ll work hands-on with Core and Product Engineering teams to turn strategic technical decisions into action and help scale the engineering organization.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Assist the CTO with strategic projects and high-impact technical decisions

  • Support engineering and product initiatives, helping define architecture, processes, and workflows that enable scalable delivery

  • Contribute to the optimization of internal technical processes, making engineering faster, more efficient, and more impactful

  • Collaborate closely with Core, Product, and Infrastructure teams to align cross-functional technical efforts

  • Take ownership of projects end-to-end, ensuring they move from planning to measurable outcomes

Your Profile

You’re a good fit for this role if you:

  • Have experience in software development, engineering strategy, technical consulting, or high-growth startups

  • Think analytically, act proactively, and can translate complex technical insights into actionable plans

  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments and adapt quickly to changing priorities

  • Communicate clearly and influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams

Why Join Us?

At Lio, you’ll work side-by-side with the CTO and Core Engineering leadership, gaining unparalleled exposure to technical strategy and product development in a category-defining AI company. You’ll own projects with real impact, help scale the engineering organization, and contribute to building the systems and processes that power enterprise AI. Move fast, own your impact, and be part of a team where technical excellence drives company success. Are you in?

Any questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Cansel.
